notes.title: Retiring Steal & Steam Episode 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've decided to remove [i]Steel & Steam: Episode 1[/i] from Steam. As a Kickstarter success and one of our first games as a studio we wanted it to be great, but it severely lacks the polish and quality we want our games to have.

We appreciate all our Kickstarter backers who believed in us and the game, and we hope you'll stick with us for future projects. We've learned a lot in the last 5 years and if you look at our games since we're proud of how far we've come.

Thanks for playing,
Red Meat Games
